paper.title: Hydrogen storage in Nickel dispersed boron doped reduced graphene oxide

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet): 144 cells, 0 numeric disputes; all 9 experimental uptakes, rGO BET 897 m2/g and the exclusion of the recalculated/DFT/literature rows confirmed. Agent C adjudication: (1) calibration point added (LaNi5 and basolite C-300 reference-sample calibration, section 'Experimental'); (2) categorical physics override -> the three 77 K uptakes (9.8/8.2/6.9 wt% on ~900 m2/g, 4-5.5x the Chahine bound and above record carbons) are Tier D (tiering doc l.33); the plausible 273/298 K rows are B; (3) B-rGO kept as reduced_graphene_oxide + dopant B (structure-preserving, HYC-0013 Fe-decorated-graphene precedent and the doped-nanotube rule; HYC-0027 N-graphene->doped_carbon noted as the competing precedent); (4) wt% basis note added (paper uses m_H2/(m_sample+m_H2), section 'Results', vs the corpus dry-sample basis); (5) rGO 298 K recorded 0.0 with uptake_bound=approximate ('negligible').

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper labels these 'hydrogen storage capacity'/'hydrogen uptake'; '(excess)'/'(total)' on p.2 describe Blankenship's values and 'in excess to that reported by Blankenship' is a comparison, not an excess-type label
notes.sa: only the rGO BET area (897 m2/g) is given in the main text; B-rGO and Ni-B-rGO BET areas are in the supplementary Table S2, which is not available, so their surface_area_method=not_reported (the paper does report an area for rGO)
notes.recalc: the Table 1 'recalculated negating the weight of B/Ni' rows (B-rGO 11.38/0.80/0.33; Ni-B-rGO 8.41/0.50/0.19) are the authors' re-normalisation arithmetic, not measurements, and are not extracted; the DFT and literature-comparison values in the introduction are likewise excluded
notes.method: PCI by a Gas Reaction Controller Sievert-type volumetric apparatus at 77 K, 273 K and 298 K to 20 bar (the method text says 20 atm, results say 20 bar; 20 bar recorded); ~200 mg sample; degassed 12 h; 99.99% H2; calibrated with LaNi5 and basolite C-300 at 298 and 77 K
notes.basis: wt% basis differs from the corpus: the paper defines wt%H = m_H2/(m_sample+m_H2) (Eq. 2), a total-system basis, whereas HyCAN-DB uses m_H2/m_sample; values are recorded as reported (no conversion, section 3.9); on a dry basis the 77 K values would be ~10.9/8.9/7.4 wt%, the 273/298 K values essentially unchanged
notes.dopeb: boron doped via boric acid added at a 1:16 ratio (the paper states only '1:16', no order or basis), freeze-dried, calcined 800 C 3 h in Ar; B content is not given in the main text (supplementary only), so dopant_concentration is left empty
notes.ni: Ni dispersed by hydrothermal reduction of NiCl2.6H2O; the paper states Ni is purely catalytic and stores no hydrogen, so Ni is a supported metal (metal_element), not a dopant, and the sample is class=composite; Ni content not in the main text
notes.implaus: the 77 K/20 bar uptakes (rGO 9.8, B-rGO 8.2, Ni-B-rGO 6.9 wt%) are far above a Chahine estimate for ~900 m2/g (~1.8 wt%) and exceed record high-surface-area carbons, so they fall under the categorical physics override and are Tier D; recorded as reported per the bias guard, flagged here
notes.rgo298: Table 1 experimental value is 0 at 298 K; the text calls it negligible and the abstract and Fig 8 caption omit it; recorded as 0.0 with uptake_bound=exact (the table prints a literal 0; HYC-0004-M1 precedent for a printed zero), with this note
notes.class: rGO is reduced_graphene_oxide; B-rGO keeps reduced_graphene_oxide with dopant_element=B (structure-preserving: HYC-0013's Fe-decorated graphene stays graphene and the doped-nanotube rule keeps the class; HYC-0027's N-doped graphene -> doped_carbon is the competing precedent); Ni-B-rGO is composite (metal-bearing)

S1.label: rGO
S1.material_description: reduced graphene oxide from modified Hummers GO, thermally reduced at 400 C for 2 h

S2.label: B-rGO
S2.material_description: boron-doped reduced graphene oxide (B-rGO) from rGO + boric acid (1:16), freeze-dried and calcined at 800 C in Ar
S2.activation_method: boron doping: boric acid at 1:16, freeze-dry, 800 C 3 h Ar

S3.label: Ni-B-rGO
S3.material_description: nickel-dispersed boron-doped reduced graphene oxide (Ni-B-rGO); Ni nanoparticles (~1-2 nm) hydrothermally dispersed on B-rGO; Ni is catalytic only
S3.activation_method: B-rGO then hydrothermal Ni dispersion (NiCl2.6H2O, hydrazine, 120 C 12 h)
